build.//buildCommand: Two concerns: (1) `npm install` not `ci` because Railpack mounts /app/node_modules/.cache and ci's wipe EBUSYs the mount. (2) --include=dev because Railway sets NODE_ENV=production at the service level, which makes `npm install` skip devDependencies — without it autoprefixer/tailwindcss/typescript/postcss aren't on disk and next/font fails with 'Cannot find module autoprefixer'.
build.//: watchPatterns are evaluated relative to the repo root. Limiting to HOA-ENTERPRISE/** stops sibling-app changes from triggering a redeploy of this service.

deploy.//: Next.js standalone server. `output: 'standalone'` in next.config.js makes .next/standalone/server.js self-contained — Railway just runs it. PORT is injected by Railway and Next.js reads it automatically. NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 stays on to keep build/runtime free of the telemetry phone-home; it no longer has any bearing on sleep now that App Sleeping is off.
deploy.//sleepApplication: App Sleeping is OFF — this service must be always-on. With it enabled, Railway suspended the container after ~10 idle minutes and the next visitor paid a cold start (often a 502 on the first request), which is unacceptable for the admin console. `false` is set explicitly rather than omitted so config-as-code overrides any lingering 'Serverless' toggle in the dashboard on the next deploy.
